purpose: Characterize whether Ross-2011-style unsaturated state coordinates regularize the revealed C3b dry-to-wet tail better than head-by-head interpolation, without changing LayeredMFP time-integration semantics.

scope.probe_set: revealed C3b dry-to-wet set, characterization only

comparison.reference: same direct steady-Darcian oracle used by F-LMFP09
comparison.baseline: C3/C4 head-by-head endpoint representation on the same revealed C3b set

thresholds: Use existing F-LMFP09 face-matrix thresholds only as diagnostics. A pass on the revealed C3b set is not qualification.

decision_rules.material_tail_improvement: C5A is promising only if tail metrics improve materially for both characterized classes without sign/coverage regressions.
decision_rules.qualification: Any promoted candidate requires a new precommitted C5b holdout with different off-grid endpoints and seed.
decision_rules.failure: If severe off-grid tail errors remain, do not tune S_e nodes to the revealed probes; move to local face solve or narrower envelope research.
